GENERAL SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

2. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters.? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrolysis? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrolysis.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrolysis.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Electrolysis.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrolysis.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Skeletal and Muscular System? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Skeletal and Muscular System.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Skeletal and Muscular System.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Skeletal and Muscular System.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Skeletal and Muscular System.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Polymers? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Polymers.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Polymers.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Polymers.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Polymers.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cell division? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cell division.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cell division.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cell division.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cell division.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Ecosystems? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on The Ecosystems.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Ecosystems.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Ecosystems.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Ecosystems.

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Carbon and its Oxides? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Carbon and its Oxides.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Carbon and its Oxides.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Carbon and its Oxides.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Carbon and its Oxides.

14. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

15. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

16. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Glucose and oxygen

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Electrostatics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Current Electricity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
